title: A Framework for Generating Valid Context-Specific Benchmarks through Expert Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.16592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end approach for generating context-specific large language model (LLM) benchmark datasets by combining expert input with synthetic data generation. Existing benchmark construction methods often trade off validity and scalability: datasets designed with domain experts can produce high-quality evaluations but are slow and costly to create, while synthetically generating data may scale efficiently but often results in unrealistic, redundant, or out-of-scope examples. To address this gap, we introduce a schema eliciting key information about the goals, scope, and context of an evaluation task, and use this information to guide synthetic data generation. We further define four criteria grounded in measurement validity for assessing dataset quality: coverage, diversity, content realism, and stylistic realism. translated_title: 一个通过专家指导生成有效情境特定基准测试的框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种将专家输入与合成数据生成相结合的端到端方法，用于生成情境特定的大型语言模型（LLM）基准测试数据集。现有的基准测试构建方法往往需要在有效性和可扩展性之间进行权衡：由领域专家设计的数据集可以产生高质量的评估，但创建起来缓慢且成本高昂；而合成生成的数据虽然可以高效扩展，但常常产生不切实际、冗余或超出范围的示例。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了一种模式，用于提取有关评估任务的目标、范围和情境的关键信息，并利用这些信息来指导合成数据生成。我们进一步定义了基于测量有效性的四项标准来评估数据集质量：覆盖率、多样性、内容真实性和风格真实性。利用这些标准，我们展示了专家信息指导的支架框架如何引导合成数据生成朝向更有效的方向发展。
tldr: 本文提出一个结合专家指导与合成数据生成的端到端框架，通过提取评估任务的目标、范围和情境信息来引导数据生成，并基于测量有效性定义覆盖率、多样性、内容真实性和风格真实性四项质量标准，从而高效生成有效的情境特定LLM基准测试数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end framework combining expert guidance with synthetic data generation, which uses a schema eliciting evaluation goals, scope, and context, along with four measurement-validity-based quality criteria (coverage, diversity, content realism, and stylistic realism), to efficiently generate valid context-specific LLM benchmark datasets.
